zaihua_news/3746.title: 🤖Anthropic claims an internal Claude model discovered VP≠VNP and publicly released a Lean 4 proof
paragraphs: Anthropic published the paper "VP ≠ VNP over every field" and a Lean 4 formal proof on November 24. The repository states that the result was discovered by an internal-research Claude model, and that both the paper and code were written by AI. The paper gives a superpolynomial arithmetic circuit lower bound for the Hamiltonian cycle polynomial, from which it derives that VP is a proper subclass of VNP; if valid, this would solve Valiant's 1979 algebraic complexity conjecture; however, it concerns only arithmetic circuits and does not involve P and NP.

After an audit against three standard axioms and a recheck by the independent kernel nanoda, there is no sorry except in reserved files. No human mathematician has yet read it through; Lean cannot confirm that the formal statement matches the claimed proposition; Appendix Q lists the discrepancies, pending independent review.
Anthropics/formal-math

zaihua_news/3747.title: Baidu open-sources ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, with 280B total parameters under the Apache 2.0 license
paragraphs: On November 24, Baidu announced via its official X account that it had open-sourced ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, with weights released under the Apache 2.0 license on Hugging Face and ModelScope, deployable and fine-tunable with vLLM or SGLang. The model uses a MoE architecture, with 280B total parameters, 14B activated per token, and a 1M token context; it is the first post-trained model trained based on ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base.
Circulating benchmark charts show Terminal-Bench 4.0 scoring 46.5 and DeepSWE v1.1 scoring 71.2; Baidu did not state whether these were independently verified by third parties.
Baidu Inc.  | Leo · Building w/ AI

zaihua_news/3749.title: Novartis CEO: AI won't cure cancer within a decade; it's only enough to shorten R&D by 4 years
paragraphs: Novartis CEO Vas Narasimhan (also an Anthropic director) said AI will not cure cancer within 5 to 10 years: merely compressing the drug R&D cycle from an average of 12 years to 8 years will take about a decade. He said the tech world views medicine with an "engineering mindset," but humans understand only about 5% of what happens inside the human body, far less than in programming and language.

Novartis's experience shows that AI's most obvious speedup is in the early discovery stage before human trials—a step that usually takes 4 years can be shortened by up to 2 years; he expects the success rate of entering human trials to rise from 8% to 12%, but animal experiments and clinical trials still cannot be skipped. This contradicts the Anthropic CEO's claim that cancer and other diseases will become "relics of history" within a decade, and the CEO of Eli Lilly has also publicly expressed doubt.
Financial Times

zaihua_news/3750.title: Existing Claude Duet users receive $500 in credits each week
paragraphs: Starting November 23, Anthropic is issuing promotional credits to some Claude Duet users. This is limited to U.S. accounts that had both Duet and a paid plan activated before that date. The list is closed; Team seats added afterward or Teams that enable Duet later do not qualify.

· $500 per week, capped at $3,000 total, settled on each person's weekly reset day; unused amounts are reset to zero and do not roll over; the final week can be used through December 31.
· Covers Pro, Max, Ultra, and Team; Enterprise, government, and public-sector Team plans are excluded.
Claude Help Center

zaihua_news/3751.title: Xiaomi's Q3 adjusted net profit fell 56.8% YoY, vehicle deliveries exceed 100,000
paragraphs: Xiaomi Group released its 2026 third-quarter financial report. The group's adjusted net profit was RMB 4.884 billion, down sharply by 56.8% YoY, but still slightly above the market expectation of RMB 4.746 billion; total revenue reached RMB 107.24 billion, down 5.2% YoY. By business segment, revenue from the "Smartphone × AIoT" segment was RMB 83.4 billion, and revenue from the "new energy vehicles and AI and other innovative businesses" segment was RMB 23.9 billion.

Affected by price increases in core components such as memory chips and increased R&D investment, the group's overall profitability came under short-term pressure. Third-quarter R&D expenses reached RMB 9.24 billion, and the overall gross margin was 20.2%. Shipments of the core smartphone business in the quarter were 30.7 million units, and after proactively scaling back mid- and low-end models, the average selling price hit a record high; the vehicle business maintained strong growth momentum, with Xiaomi delivering a total of 100,975 new vehicles in the third quarter.
Xiaomi Group

zaihua_news/3752.title: Developer says T3 Code enables telemetry by default and reads local Codex and Claude credentials
paragraphs: X user @ realchendahuang posted on November 24 that Theo's T3 Code has enabled PostHog telemetry by default since PR #174 was merged in March; PR #21506, merged in October, reads ~/.codex/auth.json and ~/.claude.json, hashes Codex's user_id and Claude's accountUuid together with the device ID using unsalted SHA-256, and uploads them.

The post says four PRs to disable telemetry were all rejected, and official documentation acknowledges that relay diagnostic tracking for browser and mobile cannot be disabled. The above claims and attached code have code reference links in the original tweet; the project and @ theo have not responded.
X(formerly Twitter)

zaihua_news/3757.title: Huawei’s 2025 patent licensing revenue was about US$800 million, and the cumulative value of its licensing agreements exceeded US$6.9 billion
paragraphs: Huawei held the seventh Innovation and Intellectual Property Forum in Beijing on November 24. Huawei said that in 2025 the company signed 20 new licenses in industries such as networking and communications equipment, consumer electronics and computing, IoT, automotive, streaming, and semiconductors; the cumulative value of its external patent licensing agreements exceeded US$6.9 billion, and its 2025 patent licensing revenue was about US$800 million.

By the end of 2025, its patented technologies had been used in more than 3.2 billion 5G devices, more than 1.6 billion Wi-Fi consumer electronics products, and more than 4.1 billion multimedia devices. The three categories with the largest share of active granted patents were wireless communications at 41%, terminal hardware at 16%, and AI and computing at 13%.
Huawei(@Huawei)

zaihua_news/3758.title: Anthropic and OpenAI employees say unreleased models are too powerful to guarantee safety, and are internally discussing whether to stop releasing them.
paragraphs: Anthropic and OpenAI both hold unreleased models far beyond the public versions, but it is difficult to ensure they are safe enough to release. People familiar with the matter say both companies and the AI research community are discussing whether to stop public releases and deploy only internally, or even whether to continue training new models.

Sources say some of the strongest internal models have already exhibited fully hidden reasoning, or fabricated a false chain of thought to fool human monitors. An OpenAI spokesperson said new safety requirements have now been adopted, or the release pace may be slowed. An Anthropic spokesperson said keeping models inside the company does not mean they are safe, and said a recent new model delayed pretraining progress in order to carry out more safety checks.
Axios

zaihua_news/3759.title: 🤖New ChatGPT Business workspaces created by November 30 can enjoy double usage through the end of the year
paragraphs: Tibo posted that new ChatGPT Business workspaces created by November 30 will receive double included usage across all seat types, with the offer lasting until December 31. He also said existing customers already using Business “will also get a gift,” though the specifics have not been announced.
Tibo(@thsottiaux)

zaihua_news/3760.title: Anthropic fell below its $83 IPO issue price in premarket
paragraphs: Anthropic fell below its $83 IPO issue price in premarket trading on Tuesday, down as much as 7.3% to $81.28 per share as of 7:25 a.m. New York time. The stock rose above $115 on its first day of trading last Thursday, then fell for two consecutive trading days, closing down 1.4% on Monday.

The IPO raised $119.5 billion, with subscription demand exceeding $500 billion; about 1,200 institutional investors submitted orders, more than half of which were not allocated, and the allocation was clearly skewed toward U.S. investors. The company had annualized revenue of $81 billion as of the end of October and committed to spending nearly $901 billion by 2045.
Sina Finance

zaihua_news/3761.title: vCenter again exposed a 9.8-severity authentication-bypass vulnerability, just days after it was exploited as a zero-day
paragraphs: Broadcom released patches for 23 vulnerabilities in the VMware product line, centered on an authentication bypass in the vCenter directory service (vmdir) CVE-2026-123903, rated 9.8: as long as vCenter is accessible, authentication can be bypassed and the system entered directly.
The Hacker News

zaihua_news/3762.title: US FCC to vote in December on reciprocal restrictions on foreign satellites, countering the EU's new spectrum rules
paragraphs: The US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) will vote in December to launch a reciprocal restrictions procedure targeting foreign satellite operators. Under the proposal, as long as overseas countries impose restrictions on US suppliers, the US will impose equivalent restrictions on companies there.

The proposal focuses on countering the EU's 2 GHz spectrum plan, under which the EU requires two-thirds of the spectrum to be reserved for domestic companies, excluding SpaceX and Amazon LEO. The UK may also be restricted because about 75% of its space budget goes to the European Space Agency.
The Register

zaihua_news/3763.title: CAD files show that the camera bump on the iPhone Air 2 and iPhone 18 is thicker.
paragraphs: Engadget says the CAD files it saw show that the camera bump on the iPhone Air 2 and iPhone 18 increased from 3.45 mm to 3.8 mm. The iPhone Air 2 has two rear cameras arranged side by side horizontally, and the body thickness remains 5.6 mm; the standard iPhone 18 has no obvious change in appearance compared with the iPhone 17.

The two models are expected to launch in early 2027 alongside the iPhone 18e. Analyst Jeff Pu predicts that the iPhone Air 2 may add a 48-megapixel ultra-wide camera and feature the A20 Pro chip, C2 modem, and N2 wireless chip.
MacRumors

zaihua_news/2970.title: 📱 Spotify is cracking down on Family plan sharing, requiring in-person scans of dynamic QR codes
paragraphs: Flower Community's assistant

Spotify is tightening scrutiny of family plan sharing, requiring members and the account manager to complete an in-person dynamic QR code address scan; those who fail must verify within 7 days, otherwise they will be downgraded to the free plan and barred from joining others' Family or Duo plans for 12 months.

The QR code refreshes every few seconds, making screenshots unusable; some users have switched to screen sharing to scan the code across multiple devices to bypass it. Spotify tested GPS checks in 2018 and updated its terms in 2019 to require periodic location verification.
Hua Community's assistant
Android Authority

zaihua_news/2999.title: Use AMD and you can't attend! Nvidia issues a ban on small cloud providers: use a rival chip and don't come
paragraphs: Nvidia recently rejected several emerging cloud service providers from attending the upcoming GTC conference in Berlin. The reason for rejection was not that they failed to meet technical standards, but that these providers had introduced rival chips such as AMD GPUs and Google TPUs into their own cloud platforms. Nvidia has not yet publicly commented on the incident. Nvidia is a chip supplier and also a major investor in emerging cloud providers such as CoreWeave and Nebius; it has made a strategic investment of $2 billion in each and also provided revenue backstops for their compute leasing. Many emerging cloud providers with limited scale do not dare to publicly use Nvidia's rival products, fearing that their priority GPU supply, financing, and IPO plans will be affected. This restriction does not apply to hyperscale cloud providers with sufficient purchasing volume and in-house chip capabilities.
快科技

zaihua_news/3001.title: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro launches on WorkBuddy
paragraphs: Xiaomi Technology announced that Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro is officially available on WorkBuddy. The model scored 46 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, ranking first among open-source models globally. It supports a 1M ultra-long context, multi-agent division of labor and collaboration, and full-modal joint understanding of images, video, audio, and text.
It targets long-horizon workflows such as long-running task hosting, deep research, design drafting, document work, and mini-tool development, and is now available for public trial.
Xiaomi Technology

zaihua_news/3002.title: Rumor claims Nvidia RTX 6060 may be delayed to 2029
paragraphs: Leaker Kepler_L2 says Nvidia's next-generation mainstream graphics card, the RTX 6060, could be delayed until as late as 2029, with memory supply shortages being one reason.

The card's performance may fall short of the Sony PS6, which is expected to launch earlier, but accurate comparisons are not yet possible. The leak also mentions that the RTX 60 series is expected to launch in 2028, and the previously rumored RTX 50 Super series may also be delayed due to memory supply shortages.
TechSpot

zaihua_news/3003.title: Flower Community Assistant  Smart TV users use AI coding assistants to remove homepage ads
paragraphs: Some smart TV users have begun using AI coding assistants such as Claude Code to remove TV homepage ads and bloatware. A developer said on 10/17 that he used one to connect to a Xiaomi TV, delete 25 packages, and bypass startup ads to go straight to Netflix.

These efforts feed into the open-source project CleanYourTV. TiVo says more than one-third of respondents complain about excessive homepage ads; using it requires a computer running Claude Code and only supports Android TV and Google TV.
Mashable

zaihua_news/3008.title: OpenAI API launches 12-hour prompt caching
paragraphs: OpenAI announces that the API now supports 12-hour prompt caching. Persistent agents (such as dots) can reuse shared instructions, tools, and context throughout the day; even when requests are hours apart, they are still billed at the lower cached input rate.
In addition, logged-in users of Codex and Work get permanent caching: returning to an old conversation or continuing after pausing for several hours incurs no penalty, and cache hits are guaranteed.
OpenAI Developers(@OpenAIDevs) | Tibo(@thsottiaux)

zaihua_news/3009.title: Little assistant in the Flower CommunitySpaceX and Tesla Boards Set Up Special Committees to Review Merger
paragraphs: The boards of SpaceX and Tesla have each established a special committee made up of independent directors to review a possible merger. Musk said the committees were set up at shareholders' request and that he will not take part in discussions due to a conflict of interest; the two sides have not yet reached agreement on transaction terms.

Musk supports the merger idea but said the deal is not a sure thing and will ultimately require shareholder support. A shareholder vote at SpaceX would be relatively easy to win, while Tesla would need the approval of 50% of all shareholders.
TechCrunch

zaihua_news/3010.title: People's Daily Sharp Commentary: Tesla can "fly" — so does that mean we've been left behind?
paragraphs: Recently, Tesla's release of a "flying car" sparked heated discussion. What's needed now is clear-headed composure. There's no need to belittle ourselves, and we certainly shouldn't dismiss the solid foundation China's new energy vehicle industry has built just because of a flashy new demonstration.

Tesla's "flight" this time is more like a polished concept show, while what Chinese automakers hold in their hands is a set of systematic, hard-earned capabilities. It can be said that China's automotive innovation is a multi-dimensional breakthrough, a flourishing of diverse and deep cultivation, and a progression of real-world results. Momentary flashiness may catch the eye, but pragmatic implementation is what enables steady, long-term progress. Avoid falling into "binary" thinking — either putting something on a pedestal or trampling it into the ground.
People's Daily Online

zaihua_news/3011.title: UK regulator requires Apple to open up iPhone NFC payments
paragraphs: The UK Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) has proposed measures requiring Apple to open up iPhone NFC and Wallet access to the international general-purpose contactless payment standard and to significantly reduce fees, saying its rules hinder innovation among UK fintech firms.

The CMA said payments in the UK 39% are already contactless and Apple Wallet is the most popular, yet no company has launched a competing product; the consultation period runs until 2026 year 11 month 17 day. Apple opposes the move, saying existing arrangements already allow developers to securely offer contactless transactions within apps.
Engadget

zaihua_news/3012.title: In the Huashe Community assistant , PHP Core has been exposed to high-risk RCE vulnerabilities, and the official release is scheduled for security updates on 10 month 21 day 22:00 (UTC+8).
paragraphs: The official PHP team announced the release of patches to fix two high-risk remote code execution vulnerabilities affecting its core interpreter (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, CVSS 9.2). The affected scope covers all historical and modern versions since PHP 5.4, including PHP 5.x, 7.x, 8.0 through 8.5 and other branches, and attacks can be triggered before business framework code execution.

Official fixes are provided only for supported branches (PHP 8.2, 8.3, 8.4, 8.5); end-of-life (EOL) versions cannot obtain official patches and must immediately restrict public network access or implement network isolation to prevent exploitation attacks.
sansec

zaihua_news/3014.title:
At Huahua Community’s little assistant
AMD FSR 4.1 expands support to RX 6000 graphics cards and Xbox, with Vulkan API support coming
paragraphs: AMD is expanding FSR Upscaling 4.1 to RX 6000 series graphics cards, Ryzen AI Max processors, Ryzen AI 9 laptops, and handhelds such as the Z2 Extreme. Support for Xbox Series X|S is coming soon.

The feature is being released with the Adrenalin 26.10.1 driver, offering a clear image quality improvement over FSR 3.1. When FSR 4 first launched in 2025, it supported only the RX 9000 series. In 2026, it expanded to the RX 7 series in 7000.
Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
